title: Age of Empires IV
provenance: Gameplay was verified locally with the standalone patched engine, Steam build 26559323, D3DMetal and MSync on an Apple M2 Max with macOS 27.2.1 (2026-11-17), including Late Siege. Smaller stutters remain. The upstream Wine patch and separate helper are being validated through highball-engine PR #49; that integration is not yet gameplay-verified.
notes: The opt-in recipe enables the AoE IV decoder/cache and selects D3DMetal. Requires an AoE IV-capable Wine 11 engine with the separate x87sidecar-aoe4 component, Rosetta and macOS 26 or later. Highball supplies the helper path when launching. The upstream engine manifest pin is pending the engine/helper release.
